Prevents the whole card from briefly switching to a loading state during a same-device entity-registry refresh.

- Keeps the working card, tank, and SVG filters mounted while the updated device mapping is checked in the background.
- Sensor readings continue to update during the check.
- Initial device loading, device changes, and genuine mapping errors keep their existing behavior. Invalid mappings are still reported when validation finishes.
- Adds unit and browser regression checks for delayed registry responses and preservation of the rendered card.
